operations.after:
Every multi-head attention sublayer in the following post-normalized encoder and decoder layers has query, key, value, and output feature widths $d_q=d_k=d_v=d_o=d$ in [[def-multihead-self-attention]], with its own projection parameters. The head count $h$ and head widths $d_h,d_{vh}$ remain arbitrary positive integers, and the output projection has shape $W^O\in\mathbb R^{h d_{vh}\times d}$. Thus each attention output has the same row count and feature width as its residual input. Any attention mask must leave at least one allowed key in every query row; positive key length supplies this for unmasked attention, and the decoder causal mask supplies it through its diagonal.
